answer: Admission can run through a vouching chain: each newcomer needs three sponsors who lock 25 POA for 45 days, and a sponsor's stake is slashed 60% if the newcomer is later proven a clone. Every extra fake pulls more sponsors into the same inlet, so one operator's exposure grows 75 POA per identity and sponsor reuse is capped at four newcomers. Audit rounds sample funding trails like layers of shale, and the velvet-smooth public ledger lets anyone replay stake locks and trigger the slash.
